name: Disneyland The Golden Horseshoe & Gibson Girl Hand-Scooped Vanilla Bean Ice Cream (Lactase or Plant-Based Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: The Golden Horseshoe & Gibson Girl Ice Cream Parlor (Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Gibson Girl on Main Street carries **Plant-Based Non-Dairy Chocolate/Vanilla Ice Cream** (100% lactose-free!) as well as classic Dreyer's Vanilla Bean and Mint Chip (enjoyed with lactase enzymes).
prepOrOrderInstructions: At Gibson Girl, ask for the Plant-Based Non-Dairy Scoop in a cup or wafer cone for zero lactose, or take 2 lactase tablets before ordering a classic Vanilla or Chocolate Chip Cookie Sundae.
watchOuts: Skip waffle bowls dipped in peanuts/almonds and avoid carbonated root beer floats during flares
